independent_raw_observations.method_boundary: Both independent raw manifests and artifact bindings are retained. The sampled field classification explains why raw HTML equality is unsuitable; it is not a claim that every differing byte was exhaustively classified.

detail_projection.algorithm: Preserve source row order; remove schema, expansion_id, parent_artifact_sha256, parent_artifact_byte_size, and parent_artifact_content_path; SHA-256 the canonical-JSON array of all remaining parent resource, document, listing-locator, order, and attachment-count fields.

attachment_occurrence_projection.algorithm: Preserve source row order; remove schema, occurrence_id, expansion_id, and parent_artifact_sha256; SHA-256 the canonical-JSON array of all remaining global order, source sequence, attachment URL/label/resource, and parent resource/document/listing-locator fields.

canonical_attachment_url_key_set.algorithm: Sort the unique canonical attachment URL strings, serialize as one canonical-JSON array, and SHA-256 the bytes.

zero_attachment_parent_set.algorithm: Sort the parent resource IDs whose parsed attachment count is zero, serialize as one canonical-JSON array, and SHA-256 the bytes.

statement: Two independently acquired 858-detail raw runs have different preserved HTML artifacts but yield identical stable detail, attachment-occurrence, canonical-URL, and zero-attachment projections. This closes attachment-discovery parity for this listing capture only; it does not resolve amendment semantics or per-clause history.
